title: Unsupported knowledge, mystery suppression, relay, and reopening

finding.title: Kira knows the private entrance and password
finding.summary: Kira states two confidential details after the draft shows she could not read the only visible clue.
finding.question: How did Kira learn both private transfer details?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: Lena shares the details privately and Kira cannot read Marcus's palm.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: Kira later states both the ambulance bay and bluebird password.
finding.inference_explanation: No on-page information path connects Kira to both details.

evidence.quote: Kira studies the writing on Marcus's palm, but his hand closes before she can read it.
When the driver arrives, ask for the word bluebird.
evidence.location: INT. CITY HOSPITAL - SECURITY DESK - LATER

finding.title: Lena knows exactly what Kira told Daniels
finding.summary: Kira leaves without speaking to Lena, but Lena later names both details Kira disclosed.
finding.question: How did Lena learn exactly what Kira told Daniels?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: Kira leaves without speaking to Lena.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: Lena later says Kira knew the entrance and password.
finding.inference_explanation: The draft does not show Daniels or Kira relaying the information to Lena.
